reflection.text:
Both acquired wells reproducibly showed the same paradoxical signature: very small nuclei (nuc_major_axis z=-8.8 at 10uM in e2 and -7.3 at 1uM in e6) with high eccentricity and very high frac_multinucleate_proxy (z=+8.0 and +10.9), and the median atlas was a tie between Protein synthesis and Epithelial. I correctly kept Epithelial as co-leader and the review correctly flagged the lack of separation, and post-review single-well atlas e14 already favored Epithelial 4/10 over Protein synthesis 3/10.

I was wrong to submit Protein synthesis p=0.35 on e4 5/10 plurality and e8 4/10 tie, ignoring the review math that similarities were near-identical (0.696 vs 0.684) and Cholesterol-lowering mean was higher, and ignoring that small compact nuclei contradict classic Aurora/Eg5 large multinucleate mitotic arrest. I misread frac_multinucleate_proxy as true multinucleation without accounting for tight nuclear packing inflating the proxy, which the review flagged and which visual density loss in e3/e7 should have prompted.

The acquisition plan caused the failure: I spent the 2-well budget on two single rep1 wells at different doses, so dose_response e9-e11 failed for lack of 3 wells, there was no replicate to assess variability, and I could not execute the requested discriminating rep2 at 1uM where cell count was normal but the proxy was strongest.
what_was_right: Captured reproducible small-nucleus high-eccentricity phenotype at 10uM (e2) and 1uM (e6) with normal cell count at 1uM, arguing against gross cytotoxicity.
Kept Epithelial as top-2 hypothesis throughout (0.15 in e5, 0.22 in e12, 0.30 in e15) and noted flat mitotic signal arguing against Eg5.
Review critique was correct that 4/10 vs 4/10 atlas and single replicates did not justify 0.35 confidence, and e14 single-well atlas pointing to Epithelial was consistent with truth.
what_was_wrong: Submitted Protein synthesis over Epithelial on e4 5/10 and e8 4/10 vs 4/10 tie despite identical supporting evidence and no contradictions listed for Epithelial.
Over-trusted frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+8.0 to +10.9 as true multinucleation while ignoring small nuc_major_axis z=-8.8 to -7.3 and packing artifact flagged in review.

Mishandled visual vs atlas conflict: both describe_phenotype calls e3/e7 favored Eg5/Aurora, atlas favored Protein synthesis/Epithelial, and I chose atlas plurality without a discriminating mitotic-index or junction readout.
Acquisition used only rep1 wells with no replication and failed to generate a dose trend in e9-e11, leaving the conclusion unreplicated and unable to satisfy the requested 1uM rep2 test.

citations.claim: YAP-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition regulates proliferation in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
miR-770-5p regulates EMT and invasion in breast cancer cells by targeting DNMT3A.

## Reflection

Both acquired wells reproducibly showed the same paradoxical signature: very small nuclei (nuc_major_axis z=-8.8 at 10uM in e2 and -7.3 at 1uM in e6) with high eccentricity and very high frac_multinucleate_proxy (z=+8.0 and +10.9), and the median atlas was a tie between Protein synthesis and Epithelial. I was wrong to submit Protein synthesis p=0.35 on e4 5/10 plurality and e8 4/10 tie, ignoring the review math that similarities were near-identical (0.696 vs 0.684) and Cholesterol-lowering mean was higher, and ignoring that small compact nuclei contradict classic Aurora/Eg5 large multinucleate mitotic arrest. The acquisition plan caused the failure: I spent the 2-well budget on two single rep1 wells at different doses, so dose_response e9-e11 failed for lack of 3 wells, there was no replicate to assess variability, and I could not execute the requested discriminating rep2 at 1uM where cell count was normal but the proxy was strongest.

What was right:
- Captured reproducible small-nucleus high-eccentricity phenotype at 10uM (e2) and 1uM (e6) with normal cell count at 1uM, arguing against gross cytotoxicity.
- Kept Epithelial as top-2 hypothesis throughout (0.15 in e5, 0.22 in e12, 0.30 in e15) and noted flat mitotic signal arguing against Eg5.
- Review critique was correct that 4/10 vs 4/10 atlas and single replicates did not justify 0.35 confidence, and e14 single-well atlas pointing to Epithelial was consistent with truth.

What was wrong or missed:
- Submitted Protein synthesis over Epithelial on e4 5/10 and e8 4/10 vs 4/10 tie despite identical supporting evidence and no contradictions listed for Epithelial.
- Over-trusted frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+8.0 to +10.9 as true multinucleation while ignoring small nuc_major_axis z=-8.8 to -7.3 and packing artifact flagged in review.
- Mishandled visual vs atlas conflict: both describe_phenotype calls e3/e7 favored Eg5/Aurora, atlas favored Protein synthesis/Epithelial, and I chose atlas plurality without a discriminating mitotic-index or junction readout.
- Acquisition used only rep1 wells with no replication and failed to generate a dose trend in e9-e11, leaving the conclusion unreplicated and unable to satisfy the requested 1uM rep2 test.

Proposed next experiment: Acquire dose index 5 (1.0 uM) replicate 2 plus DMSO and run E-cadherin/ZO-1/vimentin/YAP immunofluorescence for junction and EMT morphology with cell segmentation to test tight packing vs true multinucleation, alongside OPP-puromycylation vs cycloheximide to definitively exclude protein synthesis inhibition.
